# defectdojo_regulation (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a DefectDojo regulation by ID, name or acronym, for example one of the regulations DefectDojo comes with, for a product's `regulation_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "defectdojo_regulation" "pci" {
  acronym = "PCI DSS"
}

data "defectdojo_regulation" "hipaa" {
  name = "Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act"
}

data "defectdojo_regulation" "by_id" {
  id = 27
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `acronym` (String) The acronym of the regulation to look up, such as `PCI DSS`, compared exactly. Exactly one of `id`, `name` and `acronym` must be set.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the regulation to look up. Exactly one of `id`, `name` and `acronym` must be set.
- `name` (String) The name of the regulation to look up, compared exactly. Exactly one of `id`, `name` and `acronym` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `category` (String) The subject of the regulation, such as `privacy`.
- `description` (String) The purpose of the regulation.
- `jurisdiction` (String) The territory the regulation applies to.
- `reference` (String) A URL with more information.
